name: MixAI Key & BPM: Live Finder
subtitle: Song key, tempo & Song ID
promotionalText: Hold your phone near the music: key, BPM and Camelot code in seconds, all on your device. Song ID, set tracklists, MIDI clock and an Apple Watch app. Free, no ads.
keywords: key finder,bpm counter,tempo,dj,harmonic mixing,tuner,metronome,tap tempo,tracklist,song id,midi
description:
MixAI Key & BPM listens to the music around you and shows its key and tempo live. Everything is analysed on your iPhone: nothing is recorded, nothing is uploaded.

LIVE
• Key in Camelot, Open Key or musical notation, with the alternative and how sure it is.
• BPM with half and double tempo, beat pulse and live chords.
• Tuning (A4 in Hz and cents), energy, loudness (LUFS) and the chroma of every note.
• Key-change alert, so you notice a modulation or a new track at once.
• "Mix next": the keys that blend with what is playing, from the harmonic wheel.

FOR DJS
• Song ID: identify the track and see it in your set log, with Apple Music, Spotify and YouTube Music links.
• Tracklist mode identifies every new song while you listen; offline matches are queued until you are back online.
• Export your set as a tracklist, CSV, M3U8 or rekordbox XML, or save it as an Apple Music playlist.
• Stage mode: huge key and BPM, a set timer and a night-red display for dark booths; it opens by itself when the phone charges in landscape.
• MIDI clock out to USB, network and Bluetooth MIDI devices, plus a virtual "MixAI Clock" source.
• Your own MixAI server (optional): tracks from your library that mix with what is playing, with tempo and key-lock advice.

FOR MUSICIANS AND SINGERS
• Chromatic tuner with a reference from 415 to 466 Hz.
• Tap tempo, metronome click and a drift alarm for bands and drummers.
• Practice: the scale and chords of the key, the easiest guitar capo position and a hum test that tells singers how far to transpose.
• Set timeline: key and BPM over time, shareable as an image.

EVERYWHERE
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island with key, BPM and the next keys to mix.
• Control Center, Lock Screen and Action button control; Siri: "What key is this in MixAI" and "Identify song with MixAI".
• Home and Lock Screen widgets, a "Gig" Focus filter.
• Apple Watch app: listens on its own microphone or mirrors your iPhone, feels the beat on your wrist, tap tempo with a tap or Double Tap, complications.

PRIVACY
Audio never leaves your device. Song ID sends only a short audio fingerprint to Apple's Shazam service. Free, no ads, no account, no tracking.
